notes.title: Getting outside
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45520012/04ffce53fcfbd4471bbf451bb73597932ba2b7c1.png"][/img]
In one of the chapters, we’ll have to go outside and see how the world lives beyond our building, and that’s exactly what I’m working on now. It’s a bit challenging, but I’m managing. So far, I like how it’s turning out, and I hope you’ll enjoy it too

I think the new chapter is about 20% ready, hopefully I can speed it up a bit[/p]

notes.title: 50% of the game is already done! Yay!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45520012/b79e2e6a3d6d1417bff698af2bd27a16866dcd2d.png"][/img][/p][p]50% of the game is already done!

Today I finished developing the first chapter. If you count the prologue as chapter 0, then 2 out of 4 are done.

I really hope to finish by the end of summer, but I can’t promise anything, because game development is a very unpredictable process. Soon I’ll begin a playtest of the first chapter, as I want to make sure everything is done well and that there aren’t any obvious things I overlooked during development.

By the way, the game is participating in Steam Next Fest!
[/p][p]I sometimes post on the Discord server - join!
[url="https://discord.gg/RJbNMqcz4M"]https://discord.gg/RJbNMqcz4M[/url][/p]

notes.title: MORE PROGRESS!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45520012/0a4f3bda3eca21a5ec3cc0fd535804353fa2a4a8.png[/img]

About 90% of the first chapter is already done. Only very small pieces remain: 1 small location, and adding events for 3 locations, after which it will be possible to move on to playtests.

By the way, there will be a Steam Next Fest soon, in which HR will participate. Based on the results of the Next Fest, I will finally decide whether I need a publisher or not, because to be honest, the current stats are not very promising. I work on the project every day for 6+ hours almost without days off, and I would not like these efforts to go to waste.

Thank you again for following the development of HR!

By the way, you can hop on the Discord server, where news appears a little bit more often.

https://discord.gg/RJbNMqcz4M

notes.title: Progress
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45520012/26f3cde8a2d911f4a617dcf08618f36c1cda7948.png[/img]

I'm currently working on the most difficult part of the first chapter. Once I finish it, everything else will be child's play.

The first chapter is about 65-70% complete now

The work is going even a little faster than I expected, so I hope it continues like this.

Thanks for following the game's development!

notes.title: Patch note
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45520012/6ff361e0ebb1bdae512f8a65200b9bf4f31853d4.png[/img]

Thank you for your bug reports!

Thanks to your feedback, we were able to identify and fix the following issues:

[list]
[*]     Reworked the signal puzzle
[*]     Fixed a bug occurring upon death in the parking lot
[*]     Fixed returning to the main menu
[*]     Addressed some localization issues
[*]     Fixed a bug with blood particles
[*]     Fixed an issue with picking up empty cans from the vending machine
[/list]
